note: Average (molecular-weight) masses in daltons. Values are approximate; vendors and labs round differently.

compounds.name: BPC-157
compounds.hint: A mass near 1,419 matches. Arginate or other salt forms are different compounds.

compounds.name: TB-500 (Ac-LKKTETQ fragment)
compounds.hint: The short fragment most often meant by TB-500 in anti-doping literature.

compounds.name: Thymosin beta-4 (full protein)
compounds.hint: Some vendors sell the full-length protein under the TB-500 name.

compounds.name: GHK (free tripeptide)
compounds.hint: Free GHK without copper is colorless.

compounds.name: GHK-Cu (copper complex)
compounds.hint: Some listings cite about 404; copper isotopes also give a split pattern. A copper assay is the better check.

compounds.name: Tesamorelin
compounds.hint: The hexenoyl cap adds about 96 Da over unmodified GHRH(1-44).

compounds.name: GHRH(1-44), unmodified
compounds.hint: A listing titled tesamorelin that reads about 5,040 is missing the cap.

compounds.name: Ipamorelin
compounds.hint: Mass cannot reveal D/L errors; check the chromatogram.

compounds.name: CJC-1295 with DAC
compounds.hint: About 279 Da heavier than the no-DAC form.

compounds.name: MOTS-c
compounds.hint: Two methionines can oxidize: +16 per oxygen.

compounds.name: NAD+
compounds.hint: Sodium salt forms weigh more; ask which form is sold.

compounds.name: N-acetyl Semax amidate
compounds.hint: A different compound from base Semax.

compounds.name: KPV
compounds.hint: A C-terminal amide weighs about 1 Da less.

compounds.name: SS-31 (elamipretide)
compounds.hint: With ordinary tyrosine instead of Dmt it would be about 612.
